questions.question: 1) What enables spatial tracking in Meta Quest 3?

explanations.a: Incorrect – Meta Quest 3 does not require external sensors for tracking.
explanations.b: Correct – The headset uses built-in cameras and inside-out tracking for motion detection.
explanations.c: Incorrect – Infrared motion detectors are used in some tracking systems, but not in this headset.
explanations.d: Incorrect – Joysticks are for user input, not tracking.

questions.question: 2) What is the role of a 3D modeling tool in VR development?

answers.c: Creating digital representations of objects and environments
answers.d: Managing input from controllers and headsets

explanations.a: Incorrect – Real-time rendering is handled by the game engine, not 3D modeling software.
explanations.b: Incorrect – Lighting effects and physics are implemented within a game engine.
explanations.c: Correct – 3D modeling software is used to create digital representations of objects and environments.
explanations.d: Incorrect – Input management is handled by the VR system, not modeling software.

questions.question: 3) What does the intensity slider control in the VR lighting task?

answers.a: The size of the virtual lamp
answers.d: The direction of the light beam

explanations.a: Incorrect – The slider affects lighting intensity, not the lamp’s size.
explanations.b: Correct – The intensity slider adjusts the brightness of the light.
explanations.c: Incorrect – Color is controlled separately, not by the intensity slider.
explanations.d: Incorrect – The direction of the light beam is adjusted using a different setting.

questions.question: 4) How does inside-out tracking differ from outside-in tracking?

answers.a: Inside-out tracking uses external cameras, while outside-in tracking uses built-in sensors
answers.b: Inside-out tracking relies on cameras within the headset, while outside-in tracking requires external sensors
answers.c: Both tracking systems require external sensors
answers.d: Inside-out tracking does not involve motion tracking

explanations.a: Incorrect – Inside-out tracking does not use external cameras.
explanations.b: Correct – Inside-out tracking is based on cameras inside the headset, while outside-in requires external sensors.
explanations.c: Incorrect – Only outside-in tracking depends on external sensors.
explanations.d: Incorrect – Inside-out tracking still tracks motion, just using a different method.

questions.question: 5) Which development tool is essential for creating interactive VR environments?

explanations.a: Incorrect – Photoshop is used for image editing, not VR development.
explanations.b: Correct – Unity and Unreal Engine are widely used for VR development.
explanations.c: Incorrect – Word is a document processing tool, not for VR development.
explanations.d: Incorrect – A web browser is not a VR development tool.
